name: Score standing
description: Where a paper's review scores stand among the submissions at its venue, a venue's whole distribution, and an organisation's papers marked on each of its venues': a histogram and a curve, split by decision once decisions are out.
author: Benedict Armstrong

field.description: The score field to show, by its key in the venue's review form (rating, soundness, …). Empty means the venue's first, usually the overall rating.

splitByDecision.description: Whether to split the figures by outcome (accepted, rejected, …).
